text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every year, the academy has a summer
camp for special training. This is a great
chance for Haru
Urara to gain some
strength.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at all this nature! The sky
looks so
huuuge!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee... I've been wanting to have a
sleepover
together with everyone for so
long!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can see the ocean!
Just a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This'll be fine, right? I still have some

reservations, but in any case, let the
summer
camp begin!
